steps.name: rate-limiter-core
steps.summary: Added gateway/redis_client.py (init_redis/close_redis/get_redis, mirrors db.py, PLEXON_REDIS_URL required, wired into main.py lifespan and deploy/docker-compose.yml gateway env) and gateway/ratelimit/token_bucket.py: check_and_consume(redis, key, capacity, refill_per_second, cost=1.0, ttl_seconds=120) -> BucketResult(allowed, remaining, retry_after_seconds) and refund(redis, key, capacity, amount) -> None, both atomic via a single Lua EVAL (redis.register_script) reading Redis TIME internally, storing tokens/ts in a per-key hash; tests/test_token_bucket.py covers capacity/deny, refill, 15-way concurrency (no over-admission), refund capping, and variable cost.

steps.name: priority-tiers
steps.summary: Added gateway/ratelimit/limiter.py: resolve_tier (X-Priority header -> tier, 400 on unknown tier), estimate_tokens (word-count prompt + max_tokens-or-1024 heuristic), RateLimitDecision, check_rate_limit (per-tier rpm then tpm token_bucket checks at ratelimit:{team_id}:{tier}:{rpm,tpm}, sized from team.rpm_limit/tpm_limit * config.priority_tiers[tier].rpm_ceiling_pct, with rpm refund-rollback if the tpm check denies), and reconcile_tpm (post-response tpm refund when actual usage < estimate, no-op otherwise). Wired into gateway/routes.py's create_chat_completion: rate-limit check runs right after auth and before _prepare_request's enrichment/provider-selection, raising 429+Retry-After on denial; reconcile_tpm runs after a successful non-streaming response and via a new on_complete callback on the streaming path. gateway/streaming.py's stream_chat_completion now awaits on_complete's return value if it's awaitable (backward-compatible with existing sync callbacks). tests/test_priority_tiers.py covers rpm admission/429, batch-vs-realtime ceiling difference, unknown-tier 400, tpm-denial rpm rollback, and non-streaming/streaming tpm reconciliation; tests/test_routing.py and tests/test_streaming.py's client fixtures now also init Redis since every request touches it.
